objective: Keep recommendation, oracle decision, implementation, quality evidence, and independent review as distinct records in a synthetic workflow.
assumptions: Each record has an identity and predecessor reference
A plausible recommendation can still be implemented incorrectly
unknowns: Review depth depends on implementation risk
invariants: Approval does not imply implementation correctness
Quality evidence does not rewrite the oracle decision
Independent review is separate from implementation
A failed quality check blocks final review
acceptance_predicates: All five record types are individually identifiable
A plausible but incorrect implementation is representable
Approval alone cannot reach independent review
Review binds to implementation and quality revisions
